blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `getAssignablePoliciesWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

steps.name: getAssignablePoliciesStep
steps.description: Resolves the set of policies the actor is allowed to assign.

children.name: actor_id
children.description: Actor ID whose assignability is evaluated.

children.name: scope
children.description:
Scope context the assignability is evaluated within.
Omitted = the actor's full scope-union.

children.name: filters
children.description: Optional filters forwarded to the `rbac_policy` query (e.g. `q`, `id`, `resource`, `operation`).

children.name: pagination
children.description: Optional pagination applied to the assignable subset after permission resolution.
